intro: A New Zealand songwriter with a theatrical folk style.
story: Aldous Harding is the New Zealand songwriter Hannah Harding, whose spare, theatrical folk songs filled Party, produced by John Parish in Bristol for 4AD and Flying Nun, in 2017, the year she played Pickathon. Designer followed in 2019, Warm Chris in 2022 and Glory in 2025. Train on the Island, her 4AD record of May 2026, took her on a tour of Australia and New Zealand.
artist_reel_line: Train on the Island came out on 4AD in May 2026, with a tour of New Zealand and Australia.

story: Steve Gunn is a Pennsylvania-born, Brooklyn-based fingerpicking guitarist who played Pickathon in 2014, the year of Way Out Weather, and returned in 2017. Eyes on the Lines, in 2016, was his first album for Matador. He kept going with The Unseen In Between in 2019 and Other You in 2021, and in 2025 with Daylight Daylight on No Quarter. He toured theaters in fall 2026.
artist_reel_line: Daylight Daylight, on No Quarter, came out in 2025; fall 2026 brought theater dates.

intro: A Saskatchewan songwriter of small, literary pop songs.
story: Andy Shauf is a songwriter from small-town Saskatchewan, now based in Regina, who wrote, performed, engineered and produced The Party himself. The album was shortlisted for the 2016 Polaris Music Prize and brought him a Juno nomination for Breakthrough Artist in 2017. He played Pickathon that summer. The Neon Skyline followed in 2020 and Norm in 2023, and in 2026 The Party came back as a double-vinyl anniversary edition.
artist_reel_line: The Party returned in 2026 as a double-vinyl set with unreleased demos.

intro: An alt-rock veteran, always in motion.
story: Robyn Hitchcock first emerged with the Cambridge band The Soft Boys in the late 1970s and later moved to Nashville. His self-titled 21st album, recorded there with Brendan Benson producing and Gillian Welch singing harmonies, came out on Yep Roc in April 2017, the year he played Pickathon. Shufflemania! followed in 2022 on Tiny Ghost Records, and The Confuser in 2026, when he also remastered A Globe of Frogs with the Egyptians and went out on the road with a full electric band.
artist_reel_line: In 2026 he released The Confuser and toured North America with a full electric band.

intro: A Georgia songwriter in the laid-back Southern country mode.
story: Brent Cobb, a songwriter from Ellaville, Georgia and cousin of the producer Dave Cobb, made his major-label debut, Shine On Rainy Day, on Elektra in 2016 with Dave producing, and it brought a Grammy nomination for Best Americana Album. He played Pickathon in 2017, a year when the Americana Music Association also nominated him as an emerging act. Providence Canyon came in 2018 and Ain't Rocked In A While in 2025.
artist_reel_line: Ain't Rocked In A While came in 2025, and he joined Ty Myers on tour in 2026.

intro: A Swedish psychedelic band with pastoral jams.
story: Dungen are a Swedish psychedelic project led by Gustav Ejstes, who writes the music and plays most of the instruments. Ta Det Lugnt, from 2004, carried them to listeners abroad, and their latest album when they played Pickathon in 2017 was Häxan, an all-instrumental score to the 1926 animated film The Adventures of Prince Achmed. En Är För Mycket och Tusen Aldrig Nog came in 2022, and in late 2026 they played theater dates in Sweden and Norway.
artist_reel_line: In late 2026 they played theater dates across Sweden and Norway.
